CO1: Read a serialized transaction byte by byte - version, marker and flag, inputs, outputs, witness structure, lock time - and recompute its identifier, size and weight from the bytes
CO2: Explain what a transaction asks full nodes to do, what a node obtains from the outpoint of each input, and why the rule against double spending makes two spenders of one output conflicting transactions
CO3: Decode the sequence and lock-time fields under their current rules - BIP68 relative timelocks, the BIP125 signal, height and time locks against the median time past - and say when a transaction may be confirmed
CO4: Analyse why witnesses in the input script made identifiers malleable and broke contract protocols, and how segregated witness removes the problem as a soft fork while changing the measure of size
CO5: Check the chapter's figures and statements against BIP68, BIP125, BIP141, Bitcoin Core's sources and an independent explorer, and say where each differs and what the difference changes
_outcomes_status: approved by the owner on 2026-10-05 (all ten outcomes); LO-6 was drafted from the legacy material and the mission and this chapter is its first 2026 package
_note: These chapter objectives serve the course outcome LO-6 - to read and construct Bitcoin transactions, inputs and outputs, output and input scripts, authorization and authentication, signatures and fees, and to explain how a node decides whether a transaction is valid - and, for the parts of the chapter that follow one payment through the nodes' databases, LO-2. Reading a serialized transaction and recomputing its identifier, size and weight is LO-6's reading half; explaining the outpoint lookup, the double-spending rule and the sequence and lock-time conditions is its validity half; the malleability analysis and the segwit soft fork are the chapter's account of why authorization data moved out of the input script, which LO-6 names and which the next chapter develops. CO5 serves LO-3 as well, because its checks read Bitcoin Core's sources at the pinned commit and an explorer's record in place of a running node, which is not available in this environment. The outcomes LO-1 to LO-10 are in 01-outcomes/sen0401_outcomes_v1_1_1.ttl; LO-6's own source note says it was drafted from the owner's 2025 decks and the lineage mission because no 2026 chapter package existed for chapters 6 to 9 - this chapter is the first.
